description: Track where a satellite is right now (or in the next few seconds): get its live latitude, longitude, altitude, and look-angles (azimuth/elevation) from an observer on Earth. Use this to answer "where is the ISS right now?" (NORAD id 25544) or to locate any satellite by NORAD id. Example: get_positions({ norad_id: 25544, lat: 40.71, lon: -74.0 }).

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own N2YO API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

altitude.description: Observer altitude in meters above sea level (default 0).

norad_id.description: NORAD catalog id of the satellite, e.g. 25544 for the ISS, 20580 for Hubble.

seconds.description: Number of future seconds of positions to predict (default 2, max 300).

name: get_positions
title: Get Positions
